children: Pyxis Oncology appointed interim chief executive Thomas Civik to helm the company on a permanent basis.
The clinical-stage company also on Tuesday named Civik as board chair. Civik had been interim CEO since February and a member of Pyxis's board since 2021.
John Flavin, the company's co-founder and founding chairman, will transition to the role of lead independent director and will continue to be a member of the board, the company said.
Both of Civik's appointments took effect Sept. 4.
Civik was previously chairman of ImCheck Therapeutics, which was acquired by Ipsen, and Repare Therapeutics, which was acquired by Xoma.
He was also president and CEO of Five Prime Therapeutics until its acquisition by Amgen in 2021. He held prior roles at Foundation Medicine and Genentech.
